**BAL-SysArch-01 complete — integration contract established.** Reviewed **`45e5b9b95d099ff6288b8c9373fa01c15b2eb567`**. No files changed, native jobs run, shared dependencies modified, or nested delegation. Canonical implementation review remains pending.

The selected **balanced** layout is reproducible from the frozen study source. In-memory regeneration exactly reproduces the audited compact:

**`efc6732dd851be29b7268b0c36445ab89b01a39cfc88ce2e9b98cca788e28d8c`**

All six balanced confirmation compacts—geometric/Gaussian ×1/10/100GeV—are byte-identical to this reference. The retained native ROOT audit records zero overlaps/extrusions at **1e−5mm**, checker execution revision `e80f9826e085f3cd0ccca38e6c5b67215cf9f634`. This is existing evidence, not a newly executed audit.

The maintained generator must reproduce these physical features:

- Barrel nominal radii **31.5/57/96/182mm**, counts **12/22/18/30**. Preserve alternating offsets, all module/local-stave stacks, cooling, orientations and longitudinal positions.
- Original endcap logical IDs1–9 at **±615/865/1115/1333/1565/1780/2090/2440/3070mm**. Preserve each disc’s existing local coordinates; move the assembly rigidly.
- New logical **ID10 at±950mm**, copied from **original disc2**, including its exact local radial placement and complete module/support/cooling structure. Do not recompute parallax compensation using950mm or substitute disc1.
- Each added disc has **152 modules,302 sensitive patches and1,662 direct passive parts**. Omitting guards, ASIC/flex/contact layers, pickups, support tongues, cooling or local services would break physical equivalence.
- Expected total: **46,250 sensitive elements,54 signed layer groups,120 Gen3 volumes**. Keep existing logical IDs; layer10 remains distinct even though it is third in longitudinal order.
- Preserve pipe, all strips, readouts, world/truth definitions, cage/flanges and global service envelopes.

The first inward stave anchor becomes29.0078003mm. Its inward flex face is28.8218003mm, leaving **1.0218003mm** to the27.8mm pipe. This is positive nominal clearance, not a qualified assembly tolerance.

Ring radii must shift at both boundaries. Resulting radial intervals for layers1–3 are **40.132348–41.132348**, **64.676738–65.676738**, and **105.133192–106.133192mm**. Six rings per layer lose753.982/904.779/3015.929mm³ respectively through circumference changes; this is a real physical inventory change. Feet retain their local dimensions but change circular clipping curvature. Longitudinal cable wedges preserve volume through the source’s compensating phi-width adjustment.

Top-level attachments are essential:

- Move all three collector wedges with every disc; centres retain signed offsets **±36.7mm**.
- Clone the donor2 collector for ID10.
- Re-slot the existing four-wall rails at all ten positions, retaining **611–3134mm** rail span and **6.3mm** slots.
- The added slot removes **229.824mm³ CFRP per end**; cloned collectors add **4,155,214.9569mm³** of the donor effective mixture per end.
- Omitting these collectors or rail changes would reintroduce the known physical defects and invalidate equivalence.

The canonical verification should compare sensor IDs, centres, signed axes and bounds, passive shapes/placements, material recipes and constituent inventory against the approved reference, then perform a new complete native overlap check. XML labels may differ if physical and logical correspondence is explicit.

Existing global trunks/bypass/rear cells intentionally retain reference geometry and density. Added cumulative loads, detailed branch connectivity, installation, cooling and capacity remain unqualified. The detailed DD4hep donor assembly is also distinct from the ACTS homogeneous downstream material approximation. Its transported-map closure does not establish component-resolved material equivalence.

Consequently, preserve the historical reference configuration and performance artifacts; associate the new maintained geometry with the balanced effective map only after logical carrier correspondence is verified. No new Geant4 map, uniform momentum-preservation claim, ten-hit guarantee or engineering sign-off follows from this implementation contract.
